description: Ratio of within-vehicle belt risk ratios, driver behaviour vs reference (speeding vs not, exceeded limit vs not, BAC >= .08 vs below), unstratified and within crash configuration (single/multi-vehicle, rollover, both crossed, harmonised crash type) with inverse-variance pooled estimates across layers
population: FARS 2016-2024 light passenger vehicles with one eligible driver and one right-front passenger (Phase-1 eligibility); vehicles with unknown rollover are excluded from rollover layers
method: Evans double-pair comparison per behaviour arm and layer (crash-cluster percentile bootstrap, 1000 replicates, fixed seed independent of the other tables); log ratio of arm RRs with SE from a joint crash-cluster bootstrap of both arms (the arms share crashes, so they are not treated as independent; separate seed offset +2), 95% Wald CI and z-test; pooled = inverse-variance weighted mean of layer log ratios, Cochran Q p for between-layer heterogeneity; layers with a DPC death count below 30 in either arm are listed but not pooled
